chunks: Ḥammād narrated from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
“The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم permitted the testimony of women together with the oath of the claimant in a debt case: he swears by Allah that his right is indeed true.”

key_terms.الدَّيْنِ: debt or financial liability under dispute
key_terms.الطَّالِبِ: the claimant seeking to establish his right
key_terms.النِّسَاءِ: women whose testimony is being considered in the case

ai.seo_question: Can the testimony of women be accepted together with the claimant’s oath in debt cases?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding adjudication in debt disputes. It establishes that the testimony of women may be accepted together with the claimant’s oath to affirm the validity of his claim.
